CustomField.description: Whether a call of this tool waits for a person. Not Required runs every call, and the agent's authorization policy is not asked. Always Required waits for the Approver Type on every call; the policy is not asked. Decided by Policy asks the agent's authorization policy about each call: it runs the call, denies it, or holds it for an approver the policy names. Blank means Not Required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Not Required: every call runs. Always Required: every call waits for the approver you choose below. Decided by Policy: the agent's Tool Authorization Policy Class decides each call, and names the approver when a call must wait. Only agents with an execution identity can wait for approval.
CustomField.label: Approval Mode
